notes.title: Version 0.732 Bug Fixes Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Critical Bug Fix: when the inn is opened, if the player talks to a guest who hasn't sit down yet and click on Management actions, the game will stop working and player has to restart.
[*] Critical Bug Fix: properly handle when tasks are completed when opening the game.
[*] Many people see their screen frozen in the morning after getting new version 0.731. After changes to Lettuce Farmer Bob's quest, the quest is considered completed when players open their game. The game can't handle processing a completed quest when opening the game. Therefore screen froze.
[*] Controller Fix: Show the keyboard mouse control scheme as default, detect player input to change control scheme dynamically.
[*] Controller Fix: can't use the magical orb to collect items.
[*] UI Fix: Loading Save Menu doesn't work well with Steam deck resolution.
[*] Bug Fix: when playing attraction topic with Luka, it triggers dialogues for asking Luka questions which shouldn't happen.
[*] Bug Fix: Fix Maja leaving after summon her. 
[*] Bug Fix: Furnace isn't interactable.
[*] Minor Fix: Flower Pot price adjusted.
[*] Minor Fix: Crafting icon on the oven is too low.
[*] Improvement: Reduce the radius of the NPC collider, so player won't be easily blocked by NPC.
[*] Improvement: when learning a recipe, don't show the price of food then show the money required to learn it. It confuses people. Instead only show the recipe level and required skill.
[*] Feature: added new sounds for magics
[/list]

notes.title: Big Update to Magic Inn Prologue
notes.notes:
To our amazing Magic Inn family,

This update marks the biggest overhaul we’ve made to improve the overall experience of Magic Inn Prologue.

For the first time, this version truly reflects our vision: an unique innkeeping adventure focused on building customer relationships, embracing magical vibes, and offering deep customization. We’re confident you’ll find it both delightful and one-of-a-kind.

Here are new screenshots that gives you a sneak peek at what’s new:


🪄 New Magic Interactions with decorations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311190/9c097002dd0df1b91c5bbb18b875af163c297af7.png[/img]

✨ A brand-new user interface that’s clean, intuitive, and easy to navigate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311190/620ada78011882c73cd4d13a9b7f8141d9c6e1c0.png[/img]

📋 Refined tasks and pacing to create a smoother onboarding experience
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311190/b3f0b245ecc7656b953b3897905de5c5ca85e857.png[/img]

🏡 A beautiful inn you can decorate to your heart’s content
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311190/15457298febfa120d8f87dbfd35cb822ffe184c0.png[/img]

And just a little something—we’ve tucked a surprise at the end of Day 7. Don’t miss it!

Thank you so much for playing and supporting us!

notes.title: Patch Version 0.704: Improvements and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved camera controls, especially when the player is close to a wall, preventing excessive zooming into the player and ensuring a consistent viewing distance. Obstructions now fade using a special shader.
[*] Added support for both Windowed Mode and Fullscreen Mode in the settings.
[*] Regular customers now stay in the inn after their initial visit.
[*] Adjusted recipe prices for better balance.
[*] Improved Shift toggle for running—running now properly cancels when the player stops moving.
[*] Improved cleaning and sleeping animations to ensure the protagonist moves to the correct location.
[*] Prevented recipes from being added to the menu if there are no available ingredients.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Exiting build mode or magic mode using a shortcut no longer causes minigames to automatically enter build or magic mode.
[*] Fixed: Opening an item wheel during card selection no longer causes issues.
[*] Fixed: A shaker left behind after bartending is now properly destroyed.
[*] Fixed: Customers’ emotions are now correctly reflected in their facial expressions.
[*] Fixed: End-of-day customer reviews were sometimes lost, leading to incorrect profit calculations and missing staff salary deductions. These issues have been resolved.
[*] Fixed: Players or NPCs performing bartending actions without minigames now properly destroy the shaker afterward.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.703 Full Controller Support + Bug fixes Patch
notes.notes:
This patch provides full controller support allowing you to play Magic Inn with a controller and on Steam Deck.

It also contains several bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Food/Drink Menu user experience improvement.
[*] Bug Fix: Small bugs in crafting recipes list, buying information menu and food/drink menu.
[*] Bug Fix: the player can't to give letter back to Luka after collecting it.
[*] Bug Fix: a critical bug if the player opens item wheel during minigame, the game enters an undefined state and breaks.
[/list]

Happy Innkeeping!

notes.title: Patch 1: Version 0.702 Critical Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h1]Version 0.702[/h1]

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

When the player talks to a customer who has sit down, and when the player has learned a server skill card, the tutorial it triggers would hide the cards necessary to move forward in the game. If the player encounter this, the player has to force quit the game and start over.

Apologize if any player has encountered this issue. It has been fixed in this patch.

notes.title: Magic Inn: Prologue is Now Available
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!✨

We finally finished the [i]Magic Inn: Prologue[/i]. It took much longer than we planned, but on the bright side, we’ve implemented almost all of our blueprints for the Prologue, making it richer in content and more stable than the demo we shared a few months ago. However, with time being tight, we couldn’t playtest as extensively as we’d like. So, if you encounter any bugs or feel something in the design could be improved, please let us know. We want to shape the game together with players who care about it as much as we do.

Before you dive in, we owe you an apology that full controller support isn’t ready yet. Please bear with us for two more days and use the mouse and keyboard to play for now. We truly appreciate your patience! 

Thank you so much for your support! If you enjoy the game, don’t forget to wishlist the main game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468630/Magic_Inn/]Magic Inn[/url] to stay updated on its progress.

Happy innkeeping! 💗

Summer & Xiao
